planner.question: Can bounded-ambiguity source residuals deterministically transfer to many actual unique residuals without a randomized separation assumption?
planner.strategy: Evaluate each model's binary polynomial over a deterministically constructed finite field and enumerate all evaluation buckets; encode each bucket parsimoniously.
planner.alternative: Use per-model root bounds to obtain a multiplicity-weighted unique residual census and a promise enumeration consequence.
planner.stop_rule: No claim of deterministic isolation for arbitrary multiplicity or unbounded residual existence.
literature_leads: Elementary finite-field root bound and polynomial evaluation hashing; prior same-U randomized isolation and exact residual transfer. No novelty claim.

construct.claim: For each k,d some K>=k gives |B_k^uniq(h)|>=sum_{p in B_K^{<=d}(n)} M(p)[Q-(n-1)(M(p)-1)] at every n.
construct.scope: All original selectors with at most n^d models, fixed k,d, same U and exact clocks; transfer from some K>=k, no unconditional existence assertion.
construct.derivation: At most n-1 collision evaluations per distinct witness pair, explicit polynomial field and all buckets, unique auxiliary extension and injective alpha tag, fixed polynomial source search and exact stage absorption.
unresolved_steps: Unconditional unbounded cubic or all-exponent failure.
No numerical K or compiled original description.
candidate_tests: All small field products, model-subset bucket census, exact source/target selector model correspondence.

alternative.scope: Conditional deterministic promise search and multiplicity dichotomy, not P=NP.

unresolved_steps: High-multiplicity SAT and unbounded few-model hardness.
